title: Single-Repo Doc Checklist

# Single-Repository Documentation Checklist

Use this checklist for one-app-one-repo projects.

## 1) Baseline repository page

- [ ] Purpose section explains business/platform role.
- [ ] Scope section defines what the repository owns.
- [ ] Key components section covers core modules or flows.
- [ ] Setup/run references point to the source repository docs.
- [ ] Status section notes maturity and known documentation gaps.

## 2) Interfaces and integrations

- [ ] Identify main inputs/outputs (API, jobs, events, files).
- [ ] List critical dependencies and downstream consumers.
- [ ] Note external systems (payments, messaging, cloud services, etc.).

## 3) Practical depth target

- [ ] Enough detail for another engineer to understand why the repo exists.
- [ ] Enough detail to locate setup/docs quickly.
- [ ] No deep internals unless requested or high-risk integration areas require it.

## 4) Quality gates before merge

- [ ] Repository page is linked in `Repositories` overview.
- [ ] Sidebar order conventions are preserved (`nxt-*`, then `lorawan-*`).
- [ ] Content is concise and avoids stale boilerplate.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes.
